arStrings.szText:
{c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c_resource} seconds
{if:ADVANCED_TOOLTIP}{c_label}Lucky Hit Chance: {/c}{c_resource}{Combat Effect Chance}%{/c}
{/if}Create a binding ritual for {c_number}{SF_4}{/c} seconds that extends the duration of your Summons.

Killing {c_number}{SF_8}{/c} enemies or Demons within fuels the ritual to summon a demon for {c_number}{SF_6}{/c} seconds which attacks nearby enemies, dealing {c_number}{payload:MELEE_PAYLOAD}{/c} damage per hit.

You can have up to {c_number}{SF_11}{/c} demons active at once.

{c_important}Sigil of Summons{/c} now summons up to {c_number}{SF_23}{/c} additional demons. When {c_important}Sigil of Summons'{/c} demons kill enemies they all gain {c_number}[{SF_22}*100|%|]{/c} increased Cast Speed, up to {c_number}[{SF_21}*100|%|]{/c}

{c_important}Sigil of Summons{/c} becomes an {c_important}Abyss{/c} Skill and now requires {c_number}{SF_15}{/c} kills to summon up to {c_number}{SF_14}{/c} dark Succubi which fire Abyssal Bloodstars, dealing {c_number}{payload:SUCCUBUS_BLOODSTAR}{/c} damage and causing enemies to take an additional {c_number}{payload:BLOODSTAR_DEBUFF_DMG}{/c} damage when they try to attack.

{c_important}Sigil of Summons{/c} now requires {c_number}{SF_32}{/c} kills to summon a Hellwyrm {c_important}Greater Demon{/c} that mimics your {c_important}Lesser Demon{/c} casts by regurgitating related Demons.
Enemies within {c_important}Sigil of Summons{/c} take {c_number}[{SF_26}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage from your {c_important}Lesser Demon{/c} Skills.
Sacrifice {c_number}[{SF_27}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life to instantly pay each of {c_important}Sigil of Summons'{/c} kill costs, up to {c_number}[{SF_27}*{SF_8}*{SF_11}*100|%|]{/c} total.
{c_important}Sigil of Summons{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_28}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage but requires {c_number}[{SF_29}*100|%|]{/c} more kills per summon.
{c_important}Sigil of Summons'{/c} active Cooldown is reduced by {c_number}{SF_31}{/c} seconds when your {c_important}Greater Demons{/c} die.
